open_questions.answer: Yes. The universe grows by 1 every ~20-30 years on average. Biden (47VP/46P, P-start 2021) is the most-recent staged. Current VP JD Vance (50th VP under Trump 47 per cycle-3 post-staging audit's HYGIENE fix — corrected from cycle-2 staging's '49th VP' against current live source) is in the VP roster but has not held P office; if Vance later becomes President via direct election or succession, the universe extends 15→16. temporal_sensitivity = low reflects this slow growth.

open_questions.question: Why isn't Donald Trump (45/47 P) in the intersection? He's been President twice.
open_questions.answer: Trump has held only the office of President (45th P 2017-2021 + 47th P 2025-present); he has never held the office of Vice President. The intersection captures people who have held BOTH offices. Trump's two non-consecutive P terms are accounted for in the Wikipedia P master's numbering (45/47) but neither makes him a VP. Trump 45/47 does NOT affect this 15-row intersection regardless of his P-term count.

He is in the VP roster but NOT in the P roster, so the intersection excludes him. If Vance later becomes President via direct election or succession, the universe extends 15→16.

open_questions.question: Why is Gerald Ford's VP Number staged as plain '40' when the source table shows a footnote?
open_questions.answer: Per cycle-1 audit required edit #3. Ford's VP Number in the Wikipedia VP master has a footnote marker (rendered as '40†' or similar) because Ford was the first VP appointed under the 25th Amendment — Nixon nominated Ford to replace Agnew after Agnew's resignation 1973; Ford was confirmed by both houses of Congress rather than elected by the public on a presidential ticket. This annotation belongs in source-citation prose NOT the staged numeric cell. Other 14 VPs have plain numeric values without footnotes.

open_questions.question: What's the difference between Andrew Johnson (16VP/17P) and Lyndon B. Johnson (37VP/36P)? Both are 'Johnson' in the intersection.
open_questions.answer: They are different people separated by ~100 years and disambiguated by both first name + VP/P numbers. Andrew Johnson was Lincoln's VP (16th VP, 1865 inauguration) and became 17th P upon Lincoln's assassination April 14, 1865 (so VP Term Start Year = President Term Start Year = 1865 — same-year transition). Lyndon B. Johnson was Kennedy's VP (37th VP, 1961 inauguration) and became 36th P upon Kennedy's assassination November 22, 1963 (37VP / 36P numerical inversion). Both staged with full disambiguated names per Wikipedia VP master verbatim.

open_questions.question: Why are there 5 same-year VP-and-P transitions?
open_questions.answer: Per cycle-3 post-staging audit's prose-precision clarification: these 5 are a STRICT SUBSET of the 9 total succession-of-predecessor cases in the 15-row universe — specifically the death-succession-in-same-year-as-VP-inauguration cases where the predecessor died in the same calendar year the VP was first inaugurated: John Tyler (1841 — Harrison died one month after his inauguration), Andrew Johnson (1865 — Lincoln assassinated April 1865), Chester A. Arthur (1881 — Garfield assassinated September 1881 after July shooting), Theodore Roosevelt (1901 — McKinley assassinated September 1901), Harry S. Truman (1945 — FDR died April 1945 less than 3 months after Truman's January 1945 VP inauguration). In all 5 cases the VP Term Start Year and President Term Start Year are identical because the predecessor died early in the VP's first year of tenure. The OTHER 4 succession cases in the universe are valid succession but NOT same-calendar-year: Fillmore (1850 death-succession after Taylor died, year-after his 1849 VP start); Coolidge (1923 death-succession after Harding died, 2-years-after his 1921 VP start); LBJ (1963 death-succession after JFK assassination, 2-years-after his 1961 VP start); Ford (1974 RESIGNATION-succession after Nixon resigned, year-after his 1973 VP appointment). Ford specifically is the ONLY resignation-succession case in the universe — all other 8 successions (5 same-year + 3 year-after death-successions) are death-succession. The remaining 6 universe rows are direct-election cases: Adams (1797) / Jefferson (1801) / Van Buren (1837) / Nixon (1969) / GHW Bush (1989) / Biden (2021).

open_questions.question: Why are there 5 numerical inversions where President Number < VP Number?
open_questions.answer: Truman 34VP/33P; LBJ 37VP/36P; Ford 40VP/38P; GHW Bush 43VP/41P; Biden 47VP/46P. These reflect the fact that the VP and P numbering sequences are INDEPENDENT counters across the same chronological timeline. The VP-numbering increments faster (almost every term has a new VP; some Presidents had multiple VPs e.g., FDR had Garner+Wallace+Truman across his 4 terms; Nixon had Agnew+Ford) so by the time a VP becomes P, the VP-counter is ahead of the P-counter. The closer the gap (VP# - P# = 1) the more recent the VP-to-P transition: Truman/LBJ/Ford/GHW Bush/Biden all have VP# - P# = 1 or 2.

open_questions.question: What's the database structure of the set_operation framing?
open_questions.answer: Per db_analog: presidents CTE = Wikipedia P master rows projected with normalize_person_identity(person_name) AS normalized_person_id + president_number + term_start_year; vice_presidents CTE = Wikipedia VP master rows similarly normalized + vp_number + term_start_year; INNER JOIN on normalized_person_id yields the 15-row dual-role set; final SELECT extracts Person (from VP master per audit edit #2), VP Number (footnote-stripped per audit edit #3), VP Term Start Year, President Number, President Term Start Year ordered by VP Number ASC. The INNER JOIN on normalize_person_identity is semantically equivalent to INTERSECT on canonical-person-identity dimension; the normalize_*_identity intermediate accommodates potential name-form variants across the two masters (defensive per cycle-2 PulitzerTonyPlays + automobiles precedent). The set-operation INTERSECT semantic is preserved with cross-master name-form-tolerance.
